'''Sith dueling gloves''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were [[black]] in color with [[red]] patterning. Whether they were made by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or simply named for them is unknown.
